parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no participating member records, no shared field count, no Jaccard similarity score, and no differing-slot data — every structural evidence field is null. Without any grounded evidence of shared shape, name, or content between RootTabView (WXYC/WatchXYC/RootTabView.swift:16) and ContentView (WXYC/WXYC TV/ContentView.swift:15), no refactor action can be justified. The two types are root view entry points for distinct Apple-platform targets (watchOS and tvOS), and any structural resemblance is most plausibly coincidental given that both are minimal top-level SwiftUI container views by platform convention.
